findings.title: Installed parent-owned store probes can fail before verified close while cohort still erases their directory
findings.evidence: cleanupKnown at193-196 only joins child exit/close plus HTTP pending. ownerProbe opens a parent RU/TX owner at654/666 and closes at660/675 without registering it in cohort ownership; it then opens DatabaseSync677, runs/parses rows680-683 and closes684 without finally. initialize710-732 and I08/I09 raw DatabaseSync1115-1124 have the same missing ownership record. A read/parse/UPDATE or close failure can escape before observed close. Even though the original failure is retained and the callback fails, cohort can set cleanupKnown true and rmSync root206-208 with an unverified parent database/owner release. Child exit proves none of these parent acquisitions closed.
findings.contract: Plan4 requires actual owner release and retaining files on unknown owner state; later reopen/child termination is not proof of earlier parent SQLite release.
findings.smallestCorrection: Track each parent probe/initialization/raw SQLite acquisition as soon as returned, close in an observed finally path within existing cleanup budget, and include its verified terminal state in cleanupKnown. Keep unknown/failing release sticky and retain its directory. Preserve original errors and actual close observations, without extra callbacks/children/HTTP or invented success.
findings.validationNeeded: Static ownership coverage for every parent acquisition, then later authorized failure-path checks/observations must show unknown retains directory and successful probe records actual close. No runtime injection or probe was executed here.

findings.title: Source SQLite evidence is cumulative across callbacks and contaminates later ownership judgments
findings.evidence: Hoisted sql.rows only appends at44 and marks individual closes at48; beforeEach resets counters but never records a callback start index or resets/scopes this inventory. afterEach243 emits all historical rows under current callback, and263 uses every historical row to decide removal of current roots. S10 at815 also checks all prior rows. A previous unresolved acquisition makes unrelated later callbacks report cleanup unknown/retain their roots and can fail their closure assertion. Successful callbacks likewise emit growing cross-callback SQLite inventories.
findings.contract: Finite per-callback before-cleanup/terminal records must distinguish actual callback acquisitions from previous retained evidence; unknown roots remain retained without contaminating later ownership attribution.
findings.smallestCorrection: Capture a callback-local starting index/ownership slice or equivalent bounded local inventory before its acquisitions, and use that slice consistently for its report/cleanup/assertions. Preserve prior unresolved rows and retained-root evidence separately; do not erase an unknown owner to reset the test.
findings.validationNeeded: Later authorized collection should show callback-local SQLite acquisitions and previous unknown retention with independent later cleanup attribution; no extra callback or runtime work required.
